units.screen: Original clean-image pixels; x right, y down; origin top left.
units.rectangles: xywh = [left,top,width,height], half-open right/bottom. Manual envelopes are approximate.
units.source_texture: Decoded asset pixels; independent of screenshot scale and particle quad size.
units.filename_coordinates: Player PPOS/world tile coordinates shown in diagnostic overlay, not exact emitter coordinates.
units.projected: Static.PAK signed projected graphic-anchor coordinates. Inverse: x=ProjectedX/96+ProjectedY/48; y=ProjectedY/48-ProjectedX/96.
units.null: Unknown/not recovered, not zero or disabled.

labels.user_marked_emitter: Positive visual supervision from user underline; mechanism unproven.
labels.visual_negative_control: Selected ordinary fixture with no visibly attached separate emission in this still.
labels.context: Unmarked possible effects, runtime actors, UI or occlusion; not training negatives.
labels.unreviewed_context: Nearby archive row, possibly hidden/off-screen/inactive. No emitter label inferred.

joins: mixed.pak.group.pieces[].atlas_name identifies fixture atlas, not emitted particle texture
Texture.pak.candidates.name -> decoded_png; descriptor IDs are accompanied by archive paths
world-occurrences.item_id -> Items.pak.record_id; these whole-world rows are not emission observations

fields.name: GraphicType
fields.interpretation: Raw representation bits; not a universal particle selector.

fields.name: GraphicFlags
fields.interpretation: Separate from GraphicType; existing mapped bits include static shadow 0x0001 and light/halo 0x0002.

fields.name: MiniObjectTextureId
fields.interpretation: Texture descriptor ID when the mini-object union is applicable.

fields.name: TextureId
fields.interpretation: General model texture field; an incidental numeric lookup is not an emitter association.

fields.name: MixedBaseGroupId
fields.interpretation: Resolve through mixed.pak to composed fixture sprite pieces.

fields.name: StaticSpriteFrameCount
fields.interpretation: Fixture sprite animation field; not particle birth count.

fields.name: StaticSpriteFrameDuration10Ms
fields.interpretation: Existing static sprite timing mapping; not emission rate.

fields.name: ModelExtent
fields.interpretation: Context-dependent authored extent; not established as particle size for these fixtures.

fields.name: EffectTextureId
fields.interpretation: Existing attached-model-effect union field. Do not assume it means particle texture for a mixed world sprite.

items.provenance: Existing repository layout mappings at the hashed reader version. No new byte semantics were inferred by this conversion.

fields.name: PayloadInstanceId
fields.interpretation: Identity stored in record; exported record_id is the PAK table index.

fields.name: SpriteParam2E
fields.interpretation: Context-dependent atlas columns or source X in the existing mini-object decoder.

fields.name: SpriteParam2F
fields.interpretation: Context-dependent atlas rows or source Y in the existing mini-object decoder.

fields.name: AnimationFrameDurationTicks
fields.interpretation: Existing mini-object animation duration in 50 Hz ticks when applicable.

fields.name: AnimationFrameCount
fields.interpretation: Existing mini-object animation frame count when applicable.

fields.name: ElevationTier
fields.interpretation: Raw authored elevation tier; exported explicitly from the record.

static.provenance: Existing repository layout mappings at the hashed reader version. No new byte semantics were inferred by this conversion.

binary_cautions: Do not reinterpret unknown bytes, repeated CD bytes, or union fields without code/data evidence.
Items offset 0x2E and Static offset 0x2E have different meanings.
Existing heuristic particle/halo code and old scratch notes are context, not independently verified game behavior.
Runtime particle parameters remain null; all raw fixture bytes are retained for future work.
